headline: Loftware to Acquire Seagull Software to Expand Supply Chain Solutions
summary: Loftware has announced the acquisition of Seagull Software. The merger combines their product identification and labeling solutions to provide end-to-end supply chain tracking and traceability for enterprise clients.
why: Consolidation in the supply chain software sector is common as companies seek to offer integrated platforms that manage product lifecycle, compliance, and logistics, which are increasingly critical for global trade.
